subject.title: fix(web-media): add timeoutMs option to WebMediaOptions for remote fetches

question: Should the canonical Tlon fix use the proof-positive 120-second deadline from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104132, or this PR's 15-minute deadline and broader shared-loader surface?
rationale: Both durations correctly bound the stall but choose materially different failure latency and slow-header compatibility, while only this PR combines the Tlon fix with shared API work used by separate callers.

options.title: Select the narrow Tlon fix
options.body: Land the direct 120-second Tlon-only implementation and leave shared-loader expansion to the agent-tool callers that require it.

options.title: Sponsor the broader 15-minute shape
options.body: Retain this PR only with explicit approval of both the longer Tlon compatibility envelope and this PR's ownership of the shared loader API.

recommendation.title: Select the narrow Tlon fix
recommendation.body: Land the direct 120-second Tlon-only implementation and leave shared-loader expansion to the agent-tool callers that require it.
